risk.stop_rule: lowest observed low of last five complete sessions, strictly below current close

disabled_dimensions.strong-pullback: IS turnover and historic eligible snapshots missing
disabled_dimensions.green-raw-diagnostic: not a tradeable signal: negative net mean and negative paired excess at both T+3 and T+5

design_note: Market thresholds and liquidity floor are conservative ex-ante operational constraints, not estimates of a return optimum. An empty set of validated dimensions means no order candidates in any market. Occupying no positions is not evidence of positive expectancy.
